scenes.title: feedback-core v0.1 — real capture: report a bug from a host page

narration.text: A real host page imports feedback-core as ES modules and mounts the chromeless floating trigger
The trigger opens the reporter; the producer stamps the anchor at trigger time
The user describes the bug; the raw draft stays local
Review runs the privacy manifest, fail closed
Submit routes only the reviewed bundle, with its idempotency key, to the local sink
